analysis.session_summary: USD led the board, with DXY/USD +0.219% to 98.694 and USD mean +0.363% versus majors, despite a downside PPI surprise that triggered an inverted USD bid. EUR/USD fell 16.4 pips in a 49.4-pip range; USD/JPY rose 69.7 pips and risk-sensitive AUD/USD fell 53.7 pips as SPX/USD lost 0.45% and VIX/USD rose 4.822%. Brent/USD surged 6.046% to 108.512 on Iran headlines, driving USD/NOK +778.2 pips and USD/SEK +777.4 pips. The ECB hiked the main refinancing rate to 2.65% from 2.40%, but EUR only managed 0.201% strength against the USD, and the press conference was muted.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: The pair carved four legs within a 49.4-pip range; a -40.4-pip PPI-driven down leg led the -16.4-pip net decline, while a late 19.0-pip Lagarde bounce trimmed losses.

polarity_reads.read: Inverted: a downside surprise (0.2% vs forecast 0.3%) produced +0.153% USD impulse and EUR/USD -0.209%; positioning was short USD into the print.
Inline 25bp hike to 2.65% still lifted EUR +0.095%; the market was not fully positioned for the hike and rewarded the confirmation.
Muted -0.002% basket move after the decision shows no new hawkish signal; initial EUR strength did not extend.
Unscored 0.042% USD strength with no forecast benchmark; only mild, non-quantifiable USD supportive noise.

scenarios.name: Hot US CPI extends USD rally
scenarios.thesis: An above-consensus US core CPI reinforces the inverted USD bid after PPI, pushing USD/JPY toward its 108.9-pip up leg and keeping commodity FX heavy.
scenarios.invalidation: Core CPI m/m prints 0.2% or lower and EUR/USD closes back above 1.16194

pair_paths.rationale: The PPI leg already moved EUR/USD -40.4 pips; a hot CPI can repeat that leg size.
The measured 06:00-14:30 USD/JPY up leg was 108.9 pips and supports extension on USD strength.
AUD/USD fell 55.9 pips in its long down leg and closed -53.7 pips; risk-off USD bid keeps it heavy.

scenarios.name: Range bound into CPI resolution
scenarios.thesis: With Core CPI m/m forecast at 0.2% and prior 0.2%, an inline print lacks new USD impulse; pairs consolidate inside today's ranges.
scenarios.invalidation: EUR/USD takes out its 49.4-pip day range on hotter or much cooler CPI

pair_paths.rationale: EUR/USD range was 49.4 pips; no new catalyst to break it.
GBP/USD range was 69.1 pips; Cable can digest inside that band.
USD/JPY range was 135.8 pips; the pair consolidates after its 69.7-pip gain.

scenarios.name: Soft CPI / hawkish Lagarde triggers USD unwind
scenarios.thesis: A below-consensus core CPI or a hawkish Lagarde speech at 16:00 unwinds the USD bid and lets euro and high-beta FX retrace.
scenarios.invalidation: USD holds above DXY 98.694 close and Core CPI prints above 0.2%

pair_paths.rationale: EUR/USD's 49.4-pip day range is the measured retracement window on USD softness.
GBP/USD fell 28.0 pips; a USD unwind can recover the 69.1-pip range band.
AUD/USD's largest down leg was -55.9 pips; a soft CPI can see a symmetric retrace.

risks.risk: US Core CPI m/m and y/y print hot
risks.why_it_matters: After the inverted PPI reaction, an above-forecast core CPI can extend the USD bid rather than relying on risk-off; Core CPI m/m is forecast 0.2% with prior 0.2%.
ECB press conference was muted; later comments can reframe the hike and move EUR/USD from its 1.16194 close.
CHF was only +0.043% on the day; any SNB guidance can move USD/CHF and EUR/CHF.
risks.watch: USD/CHF 62.7 range pips, EUR/CHF 35.5 range pips

risks.why_it_matters: Brent already rose 6.046% on Iran headlines; further spikes can boost USD/NOK, USD/SEK and risk-off USD.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: Next session brings high-impact GBP GDP m/m (f/c 0.0% vs prev 0.3%), SNB's Schlegel, then US Core CPI m/m (f/c 0.2%), CPI y/y (f/c 3.4%), and preliminary UoM sentiment (f/c 51.0); Lagarde's 16:00 speech adds another layer. A hot CPI would extend USD strength; a soft print can unwind the PPI inversion.
